recent_observations.market_summary: The morning relief-rally setup turned into a mixed, choppy rotation day: the Dow pushed above 52,000 while the S&P 500 and Nasdaq faded as crowded tech and chip momentum cooled. VIX stayed contained near the mid-teens and oil fell on US-Iran/Strait of Hormuz relief, but the tape punished extended AI and fintech headlines into the Fed decision.
key_drivers: US-Iran/Strait of Hormuz relief kept oil lower and volatility contained, supporting cyclicals and the Dow.
Fed-decision risk and crowding after a three-day relief rally drove profit-taking in Nasdaq, chips, and speculative fintech.
Stock-specific AI/storage and restructuring headlines produced sharp dispersion rather than broad risk-on follow-through.

thesis_review.thesis: Relief from energy/geopolitical stress should keep buyers engaged in liquid growth and industrial/defense-adjacent names if oil stays contained, VIX remains near the mid-teens, and indexes hold the post-relief breakout range.
thesis_review.evidence: Oil and VIX confirmed the relief inputs, but Nasdaq and S&P faded while the monitored longs slipped below their execution zones by the afternoon.
thesis_review.entry_quality_lesson: Macro relief alone is not enough after a three-day squeeze; require relative-strength and VWAP confirmation before treating a headline gap as swingable.

thesis_review.thesis: QCOM can extend if Tenstorrent AI-chip speculation and semiconductor risk appetite hold while price stays above post-news support.
thesis_review.evidence: QCOM opened strong but later traded below the 224.00-229.50 buy range and under the 220.50 stop reference, while semiconductor leadership faded.
thesis_review.entry_quality_lesson: The morning buy range was fair only early; once QCOM lost the planned support zone, the catalyst became a crowded headline rather than a valid long setup.

thesis_review.thesis: GM can grind higher if Lockheed/defense-production headlines create a new institutional narrative while lower oil supports autos.
thesis_review.evidence: GM initially sat in the 84.00-86.00 band but never provided the required VWAP confirmation and later fell below the entry window as market tone deteriorated.
thesis_review.entry_quality_lesson: For slower industrial narratives, a first-hour VWAP hold matters; buying the headline without that hold would have converted a fair setup into a late chase.

thesis_review.thesis: WDC and MU should be watched for AI/storage continuation only after digestion because the gap was crowded.
thesis_review.evidence: WDC remained a standout mover but MU reversed lower and broader chip breadth weakened, validating the decision to avoid chasing the group at the open.
thesis_review.entry_quality_lesson: Extended AI/storage leaders can still work, but the system should demand pullback-or-base entries when crowding risk is explicitly high.

thesis_review.thesis: HOOD can benefit if risk appetite and trading activity remain strong, but layoffs alone are insufficient for a high-conviction buy.
thesis_review.evidence: HOOD stayed far below the 124 watch reference and the layoff narrative did not create a durable opening-range hold.
thesis_review.entry_quality_lesson: Efficiency headlines need market-confirmed accumulation; workforce cuts are not automatically bullish when fintech beta is fading.

proposals.title: Track missed mover reason codes
proposals.description: Missed opportunities came from regulatory catalysts, newly public mega-cap momentum, and overlooked semiconductor packaging news. Store missed-mover reason codes so screening gaps can be measured over multiple reflections.
proposals.expected_impact: Turns anecdotal missed opportunities into a prioritized data-source backlog.

proposals.title: Require breadth confirmation for risk-on labels
proposals.description: The morning regime was risk_on because oil and VIX improved, but the close was mixed with Nasdaq weakness. Regime classification should require breadth, QQQ/SPY behavior, and sector participation before enabling growth-stock buys.
proposals.expected_impact: Avoids overallocating to crowded growth names during relief rallies that rotate into Dow cyclicals or defensives.

proposals.title: Add FDA and company-specific event mover scan
proposals.description: The system missed Moderna's large FDA-briefing-document move while watching weaker headline setups. The morning screen should include FDA calendars, briefing documents, and same-day regulatory catalysts for liquid healthcare names.
proposals.expected_impact: Broadens opportunity capture beyond AI and macro-relief themes, especially on mixed index days where healthcare leads.

proposals.title: Auto-downgrade failed buy ranges after stop-reference breach
proposals.description: QCOM moved from inside/near the buy range to below the planned stop reference, but remained in the same watch loop. A candidate that trades below its planned stop before entry should require a fresh thesis and a new setup before it can be considered again.
proposals.expected_impact: Reduces temptation to bottom-fish failed catalyst gaps and keeps the system from recycling invalidated entries.

proposals.title: Separate buy confidence from avoid confidence
proposals.description: Late-day monitor confidence rose above 0.75 for QCOM, GM, and HOOD even though all were watch/avoid decisions. Confidence should be directional and action-specific so high confidence to avoid cannot be misread as high confidence in the original long thesis.
proposals.expected_impact: Prevents stale bullish candidates from appearing stronger after they fail gates and improves next-day calibration.
